title.zh: 乐器维修服务柜台协调员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain traceable intake records that distinguish customer-reported symptoms from technician findings.
requirements.zh: 维护可追溯受理记录，区分客户报称症状与技师发现。

requirements.en: Prepare approved quotes and record customer acceptance before work is queued.
requirements.zh: 准备获批报价，并在维修排队前记录客户接受情况。

requirements.en: Coordinate ready-for-collection appointments and retain collection receipts.
requirements.zh: 协调可取件预约，并保留取件收据。

requirements.en: Track loan-instrument return dates and escalate overdue returns.
requirements.zh: 跟踪代用乐器归还日期，并上报逾期归还。

requirements.en: Preferred: perform routine violin setup and string replacement for customers.
requirements.zh: 优先：为客户进行常规小提琴调校及换弦。
